name: Tea Bowl with Indented Lip and Silvery-Brown Hare's-Fur Markings
summary: The walls of this large yankou wan, or funnel-shaped, tea bowl expand from the small, circular foot, beginning their steep ascent to the lightly indented, vertical lip at an angle approximately one-half inch above the foot. Thin at the rim, the walls thicken as they descend, so the relatively heavy bowl has a low-set center of gravity. material: Jian ware: dark gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in iron oxide, the lip banded with metal. From the kilns at Shuiji, Jianyang county, Fujian province.
